description: Financial Planning & Analysis at Northwind Logistics. Owns the forecast vs. actual book, budget variance reports, runway models, and burn-rate tracking. Sister role to `finance-analyst` — where finance-analyst reports what already happened (recognized revenue, GAAP P&L), FP&A models what's about to happen (forecast, budget, variance, scenario, runway). Reads from `public.budget_lines`, `public.forecasts`, `public.actuals`, `public.cash_balances` — joins to `public.opex_categories` and `public.scenarios`.
